none: PAS LEIC-6CF3E5: Roman copper alloy steelyard fragment
contea di ritrovamento: Leicestershire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Roman copper alloy Steelyard balance fragment, 44mm long, 12mm wide and 2mm thick. The object is in fair condition and weighs 5.66grams. The object is rectangular in form and consists of a circular sectioned shaft which gradually becomes rectangular in section. On one edge it has a complete circular suspension loop.
